chapter: Moten band, Kansas City and the evolution of jazz
title: From Trumbauer to Benny Carter as his alto idol
summary: He had not yet met Hawkins in person; he switched his model to Benny Carter, whom he still calls the greatest all-round alto player and the creator of lead-alto style.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Had you run into Coleman Hawkins by this time?

I hadn't seen my idol yet, you know. But in the meantime I picked up on Benny Carter who I felt was the greatest alto player, you know. Because then I started thinking I liked Benny Carter. I started to try to play him, emulate, you know, tried to pick up his style of playing because after him, I think, I graduated from Trombauer to Benny Carter who today I still think is the greatest all around alto player in the world. Because he set the style for lead playing and he set the style for all these things.
